headline: Binance Confirms Major Security Breach, Freezes Over $2.5 Billion
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance confirmed a major hack, freezing more than $2.5 billion in assets. The full scope of the heist was not immediately known.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, making its security incidents critical for digital asset liquidity and market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security breaches at major exchanges frequently undermine investor confidence across the digital asset market.
